# Copilot instructions

- Start with [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the issue, and its direct prerequisites. Use the accepted ADRs for architecture. Keep the deployed prototype usable during the rebuild.
- Save context with path-scoped searches, bounded reads, and focused diffs. Run targeted checks first and expand when shared behavior changes. Summarize long logs with the failing command, actionable error, and relevant lines.
- Keep replies and PR descriptions concise. Preserve decisions, reproduction steps, test evidence, and blockers. Use specialized skills only for matching work.
